info.title: EMI-at-Counter Copilot API
info.description: REST contract for the merchant and customer apps. JSON is camelCase, money is integer paise (never a float) and every error is an RFC 7807 problem with a stable code.

get.summary: List the EMI offers for an item
get.description: Asks the payment gateway for every EMI plan on one item at one price and returns them in the gateway's order; no plan is hidden or ranked. monthlyInstallmentInPaise is the lender's quoted figure; the last installment, extra in total and total payable come from our exact schedule, which adds up to the paisa (ADR 0001). Layer 1 gateway endpoint: unauthenticated until merchant authentication arrives in Layer 2 (ADR 0009). Money is integer paise; errors are application/problem+json.

post.summary: Create a payment link for the chosen plan
post.description: Re-quotes the chosen offer server-side, freezes its plan and asks the gateway for a payment link exactly once per Idempotency-Key; the call is never retried. The same key and body return the original 201 response. A gateway timeout answers 504 and the key then answers 409 PAYMENT_LINK_OUTCOME_UNKNOWN: start again with a new key (ADR 0005). Location points at the payment's status. Layer 1 gateway endpoint: unauthenticated until merchant authentication arrives in Layer 2 (ADR 0009). Money is integer paise; errors are application/problem+json.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key

schema.description: Required. 8 to 255 visible ASCII characters, no spaces (a UUID or ULID is ideal). The same key with the same body returns the original 201 response; with a different body it is refused with 422 IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED (ADR 0005).

get.description: Asks the gateway about the order server-side, applies the answer and returns the public status: CREATING_LINK, LINK_FAILED, OUTCOME_UNKNOWN, AWAITING_PAYMENT, PAYMENT_PENDING, PAID or PAYMENT_FAILED. A client's word is never taken as a status. amountPaidInPaise is set only when paid. Layer 1 gateway endpoint: unauthenticated until merchant authentication arrives in Layer 2 (ADR 0009). Money is integer paise; errors are application/problem+json.

post.summary: Receive a payment notification from the gateway
post.description: Called by the payment gateway, not by our apps. The body is form-encoded key/value text [Verify] of at most 16 KiB. Its signature (CHECKSUMHASH) is verified over every field before any field is read; a mismatch answers 401 and is audited. A verified notification answers 202 with no body, also when it repeats an earlier one (no extra effect) or names an order that is not ours. Authenticated by the signature only; no credentials (ADR 0009).

CreatePaymentLinkRequest.title: CreatePaymentLinkRequest
CreatePaymentLinkRequest.description: The plan the customer chose for one item; every figure is re-quoted server-side.

EmiOfferResponse.title: EmiOfferResponse
EmiOfferResponse.description:
One EMI plan: the lender's monthly figure beside our exact schedule totals (ADR 0001).

monthlyInstallmentInPaise is the lender's quoted figure. The other amounts come from our
schedule: the remainder sits on the last installment, so the installments add up to
totalPayableInPaise exactly.

EmiType.title: EmiType
EmiType.description: The pricing kind of an EMI plan; stored by value inside frozen offer snapshots.

FieldErrorResponse.title: FieldErrorResponse
FieldErrorResponse.description: One invalid request field, named as on the wire, with an English message.

HealthResponse.title: HealthResponse
HealthResponse.description: Body returned by GET /health while the process is able to serve requests.

OfferSnapshotResponse.title: OfferSnapshotResponse
OfferSnapshotResponse.description:
The exact plan frozen when the link was made: tenure - 1 regular installments, then a last.

The amounts are our schedule's, so they add up to totalPayableInPaise to the paisa.

OffersResponse.title: OffersResponse
OffersResponse.description: Every offer the gateway quotes for the item, in the gateway's order; none is hidden.

PaymentLinkResponse.title: PaymentLinkResponse
PaymentLinkResponse.description:
The link to hand to the customer, as created; poll the Location URL for later status.

status is always the status the link had when it was created (AWAITING_PAYMENT), so a replay
with the same Idempotency-Key returns exactly the original response (api-conventions.md
section 5). The current status is served by GET /api/v1/payments/{orderId}/status.

PaymentStatusResponse.title: PaymentStatusResponse
PaymentStatusResponse.description:
Where one payment stands, confirmed with the gateway server-side on this request.

amountPaidInPaise is set only when the gateway reports the payment as paid; it can be below
the link amount when a discount applied.

detail.title: Detail
examples: The chosen offer is not quoted for this item and price.

fieldErrors.title: Fielderrors
fieldErrors.description: Set only on request validation problems.

ProblemDetailsResponse.title: ProblemDetailsResponse
ProblemDetailsResponse.description:
An error: a stable code for the UI to translate and an English detail for developers.

It never holds a stack trace, SQL, a vendor payload or personal data.

PublicPaymentStatus.title: PublicPaymentStatus
PublicPaymentStatus.description:
Where a payment stands, as the UIs see it; decoupled from the stored attempt status.

The stored statuses may be renamed or split later without breaking the wire contract.
